css: .print-format{page-size:Custom;page-width:100mm;page-height:50mm;margin:0;width:100mm!important;max-width:100mm!important;min-height:50mm!important;height:50mm!important;padding:0!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;overflow:hidden}@page{size:100mm 50mm;margin:0}html,body{width:100mm;height:50mm;margin:0;padding:0;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000}.bin-label{width:100mm;height:50mm;border:.8mm solid #000;box-sizing:border-box;padding:2mm;display:grid;grid-template-rows:6mm 30mm 8mm;gap:1mm;overflow:hidden}.label-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border-bottom:.5mm solid #000;font-size:9px}.label-head b{font-size:11px}.label-head span{font-weight:900;border:1px solid #000;padding:.5mm 2mm}.label-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 27mm;gap:3mm}.details span{display:block;font-size:7px;font-weight:700}.details strong{display:block;font-size:22px;line-height:1.1;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}.details dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:21mm 1fr;margin:2mm 0 0;font-size:7px;line-height:1.35}.details dt{font-weight:900}.details dd{margin:0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.qr{text-align:center;border-left:.4mm solid #000;padding-left:2mm}.qr img{width:24mm;height:24mm}.qr small{display:block;font-size:6px;font-weight:900}.barcode{height:8mm;border-top:.3mm solid #000;padding-top:.7mm}.barcode svg{width:100%;height:100%}@media screen{.print-format{width:100mm!important;max-width:100mm!important;min-height:50mm!important;height:50mm!important;padding:0!important}.print-format-gutter{padding:10px 0!important}}
